draftInquiry.subject: Access inquiry: 1984 Zapote river-mouth fish thesis (TU03120)
draftInquiry.body:
Hello DLSU Libraries,

I am researching historical fish evidence for Bangwit, an independent project to build a source-backed Philippine fishing information app. I found the Animo Repository catalog entry for the 1984 thesis ‘Heavy metal contamination of water, sediments plankton, invertebrates and fish on three river mouths along Manila Bay: Navotas, Pasig and Zapote’ (accession TU03120; Archives, The Learning Commons, 12F).

Could you please advise whether an external researcher may consult this print item, and what identification, appointment, or access requirements apply? If consultation is not available, is an authorized scan of the relevant fish methods/results pages available? I am especially seeking the reported fish names, sampling date and station/locality details, identification method, and any specimen or catalog references. Please also advise the item-specific citation and reuse terms for any derived species records.

This is an access inquiry only; I will not reproduce tables or publish thesis-derived records without your guidance.

Thank you,
[Name]

interpretation.whatTheRecordSupports: A bibliographic retrieval lead for a thesis whose title identifies fish as one study component and includes the Zapote river mouth among three Manila Bay river-mouth sites.
interpretation.whatItDoesNotSupport: No fish taxon, exact sampling station, survey date, method, specimen, current-presence, full river checklist, water-quality result or reusable data claim can be made from the catalog metadata alone.
interpretation.nextAction: If the project owner chooses, send the prepared inquiry to the indexed DLSU Libraries contact. Confirm external access or authorized scanning and reuse terms before transcribing any table or publishing derived records.

rightsAndUse.decision: Retain as a retrieval lead only. Do not derive species records from the title or catalog metadata.
